answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the fable of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations. The horizon holds work receipts rather than names, so the spiral of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
